items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Solid, secondary, outline, ghost, link and destructive buttons with a loading state and asChild for links.
items.docs: Use asChild to render the styles on a Next Link. loading disables the button and shows a spinner.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Status and metadata labels with success, warning, destructive, outline and muted tones.
items.docs: Status badges carry text as well as colour; never rely on the tone alone.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A loading placeholder in the shape of the content, with a shimmer sweep instead of a pulse. Give siblings a delay so the sweep runs as one wave.
items.docs: Match the real layout: a skeleton that does not hold the final shape shifts the page when the data arrives.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A hairline rule, horizontal or vertical, decorative by default.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A keyboard key for shortcut hints, with a group for combinations.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text input with focus ring, invalid state and file input styling.
items.docs: Pair with Label via htmlFor. Set aria-invalid from your form library to show the error state. fieldSurface is the same surface for Textarea and the Select and Combobox triggers.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: A form label that focuses its control on click.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A tooltip on hover and focus, with a shared provider so a row of controls feels like one surface.
items.docs: Wrap your app once in TooltipProvider. A tooltip is never the only place a label lives.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal dialog with focus trap, Escape and backdrop close, and a required title and description.
items.docs: Every DialogContent needs a DialogTitle; hide it visually with sr-only if the design has no heading.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel that slides in from any edge: menus, carts, filters. Same accessibility contract as Dialog.
items.docs: Pass side left, right, top or bottom. Sheets slide on transform only.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs with arrow-key navigation, as an underline (line) or a segmented control (pill).
items.docs: Give TabsList the group/list class so the triggers pick up the variant.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A filtered, keyboard-driven list on cmdk, inline or as a palette in CommandDialog.
items.docs: CommandDialog brings its own Command root: put CommandInput and CommandList straight inside. It carries a hidden title and description for screen readers.

items.name: rhs-ui-theme
items.title: RHS UI theme
items.description: The RHS UI colour theme: a violet brand ramp on a constant OKLCH hue and a violet-tinted neutral scale, measured for WCAG AA in light and dark. Drops into any shadcn project as the semantic tokens.
items.docs: Installs the RHS semantic tokens into your globals.css. Your components keep their names (bg-background, text-primary); only the values change.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Keyboard-friendly disclosure rows with single or multiple expanded items.

items.name: accordion-demo
items.title: accordion demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the accordion component.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An accessible binary switch with form support and controlled or uncontrolled state.

items.name: switch-demo
items.title: switch demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the switch component.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: An accessible value or range slider with keyboard controls and labelled thumbs.

items.name: slider-demo
items.title: slider demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the slider component.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A checkbox with a visible box at rest, a check and an indeterminate dash, keyboard and form support.
items.docs: Set checked="indeterminate" on a parent whose children are partly chosen. With a name it submits like a native checkbox.

items.name: checkbox-demo
items.title: checkbox demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the checkbox component.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: One choice out of a few: arrow keys move and choose, the circle is visible at rest.
items.docs: Name the group with aria-label or a fieldset legend. Wrap an item and its text in a Label to make the whole row clickable.

items.name: radio-group-demo
items.title: radio group demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the radio group component.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A select on the field surface with our own listbox: groups, a second line per option, typeahead, never the browser menu.
items.docs: Opens under the field (position popper). With a name, Radix keeps a hidden, aria-hidden native select in sync for FormData and autofill; nobody sees or reaches it.

items.name: select-demo
items.title: select demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the select component.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A field that opens a searchable list, for choices too long to scan: countries, time zones, customers.
items.docs: Search matches the label and the keywords. With a name, a hidden input carries the value; validate required in your form schema.

items.name: combobox-demo
items.title: combobox demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the combobox component.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line field on the same surface as Input that grows with its text where the browser supports it.
items.docs: Uses field-sizing: content; older browsers fall back to rows and the resize handle.

items.name: textarea-demo
items.title: textarea demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the textarea component.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A panel anchored to its trigger for a small form or filters. Exports the panel surface every floating layer shares.
items.docs: Focus moves in on open and back on close. panelSurface keeps Select, Dropdown menu and Combobox on the same panel.

items.name: popover-demo
items.title: popover demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the popover component.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: A menu of actions: shortcuts, toggles, a choice of one, submenus and a destructive item, fully keyboard driven.
items.docs: For actions only. Navigation between pages belongs in links, not a menu.

items.name: command-demo
items.title: command demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the command component, inline and as a palette.

items.name: dropdown-menu-demo
items.title: dropdown menu demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the dropdown menu component.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Short notices with a toast() call and one Toaster: tones, an action, swipe to dismiss, pause on hover, F8 to reach them.
items.docs: Mount one Toaster near the root and call toast() from any event handler. Reuse an id to turn Saving into Saved.

items.name: toast-demo
items.title: toast demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the toast component.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Semantic table parts with a caption, its own horizontal scroll and a sortable header that sets aria-sort.
items.docs: Give TableHead sort and onSort to make it a sort button. Mark a selected row with data-state="selected".

items.name: table-demo
items.title: table demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the table component.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A surface for one piece of content: header with title, description and action, content and footer.
items.docs: CardTitle is an h3; pass asChild with your own heading when the outline needs another level.

items.name: card-demo
items.title: card demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the card component.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person or workspace as a circle: the image when it loads, initials when it does not, and overlapping groups.
items.docs: initialsOf(name) gives the fallback letters. Give AvatarImage an alt, or alt="" when the name is written next to it.

items.name: avatar-demo
items.title: avatar demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the avatar component.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A determinate or indeterminate progress bar that holds still under reduced motion.
items.docs: Name it with aria-label or aria-labelledby. Pass getValueLabel for an answer like "2 of 5 files".

items.name: progress-demo
items.title: progress demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the progress component.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Links between pages with a fixed-width page range, the current page marked and Previous and Next kept readable.
items.docs: paginationRange(current, total) returns the pages and gaps to draw. Pass asChild to render your router's link.

items.name: pagination-demo
items.title: pagination demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the pagination component.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Where a page sits: an ordered list of links ending in the current page, with collapsible middle crumbs.
items.docs: The last crumb is BreadcrumbPage (aria-current, not a link). Separators are hidden from screen readers.

items.name: breadcrumb-demo
items.title: breadcrumb demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the breadcrumb component.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation menu
items.description: Site navigation with panels in one shared viewport that resizes between them, on hover and keyboard.
items.docs: Set viewport={false} and place NavigationMenuViewport yourself when the panel must sit elsewhere, like under a full-width header.

items.name: navigation-menu-demo
items.title: navigation menu demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the navigation menu component.
